key_insight: OpenVLHarness improves visual reasoning by enabling models to acquire, retain, and compute over external multimodal evidence rather than relying only on more inference.
engineering_relevance: A unified tool layer and persistent evidence store offer a reusable architecture for visual agents that combine perception, web knowledge, and numerical computation.
method: Expose heterogeneous tools through task-level interfaces and render outputs as model-readable observations.
Retain images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query.
Execute generated code over stored evidence to combine tool results across reasoning steps.
evidence_signal: Across 22 benchmarks and eight backbones, reported gains were 9.7–12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines; GPT-6 Luna at medium effort beat maximum-effort comparators by 7.7–8.5 points using at most 37% of their model-token cost.
watch_item: Model-token savings do not establish lower end-to-end cost or latency; tool execution, evidence storage, and generated-code safety require separate assessment.
paper_title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
